LZFSE decoder from @chrispeoples/aea 0.1.0 (MIT), a port of Apple lzfse (BSD-3-Clause).
Source: https://github.com/cpeoples/signet/tree/main/packages/aea
Changes: OutBuffer returns Uint8Array for browsers and caps decoded output at 64 MB.

fflate 0.8.3 (MIT), unmodified esm/browser.js. Source: https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate
Used for ZIP creation in a dedicated module worker; no CDN or nested workers.
